content.title: Events namespace: replace agt history with agt events list/add + type filtering
content.description: Replace the current `agt history <issue-id>` command with a new `agt events` namespace that: (1) `agt events list <issue-id>` returns raw events (replacing `history`); (2) `agt events list <issue-id> --type <event-type>` filters events by type; (3) `agt events add <issue-id> <event>` stores a custom event from a JSON object with a `type` (must not collide with agentrack default types) and a `content` JSON object, with agentrack auto-adding `timestamp` and `author`. Covers library core (events, tracker API), types, and CLI command wiring.
